simulations.name: Clemir Studio Pro — Usage vs. Seat Pricing Analysis
simulations.description: Evaluating customer response to a three-tier SaaS pricing model ($0 Starter, $149 Growth flat-rate, Custom Enterprise) versus per-seat billing for a B2B product analytics workflow.

simulations.researchObjectives: Identify optimal price anchor for Growth tier, test resistance to $149/mo price point, and uncover must-have features in the Free Explorer tier.

pricingTiers.name: Growth

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise

materials.extractedContent: Competitor benchmark shows legacy research panels charge $2,500+ per study with 2-week turnaround. Flat-rate $149/mo unlimited simulation model positions Clamir as an everyday decision tool.

questions.text: Which pricing tier best matches your workflow and budget expectations?
How do you feel about flat-rate workspace pricing ($149/mo) compared to per-seat pricing ($39/user/mo)?
Rate the perceived value of the Growth tier at $149/month.

results.simulationNotice: SIMULATED FEEDBACK NOTICE: All responses, scores, and statements below are AI-generated audience simulations produced by Clemir Engine and do not represent actual human survey respondents.

executiveSummary.mainFinding: 78% of simulated personas favored the flat-rate workspace model over per-seat pricing, with strong conversion intent on the $149/mo Growth tier when positioned against traditional $2,500+ research panels.
executiveSummary.overallReaction: Broadly positive reception across Quality Seekers (88/100 acceptance) and Convenience Seekers (82/100), while Value Optimizers requested a mid-tier bridge or annual discount option before committing to $149/mo.
importantOpportunities: Highlight cost comparison against traditional consumer research panels directly on the pricing card
Include 1 sample PDF export in the Free Explorer tier so Value Optimizers can verify deliverable quality before upgrading
Offer a 20% annual billing discount ($119/mo equivalent) to accelerate budget approval
mainConcerns: Jump from $0 Explorer to $149/mo Growth feels steep for solo founders running only 6–8 simulations per month
Quality Seekers want explicit clarity on how custom persona calibration differs between Growth and Enterprise
